description: Defines an abstract class IndexCreator for managing app repository indexing, including icon extraction, APK linking, file hashing, and native code parsing.

classes.name: IndexCreator
classes.description: An abstract class for creating and managing app index repositories, handling icon extraction, APK linking, native code parsing, and repository setup.

methods.name: prepareIconFolders
methods.description: Creates icon directory and symlinks for various icon sizes.

methods.name: copyIconToRepo
methods.description: Extracts app icon from PackageInfo and saves as PNG in repo.

methods.name: copyApkToRepo
methods.description: Symlinks or copies APK file into the repository directory.

methods.name: hashFile
methods.description: Calculates SHA-256 hash of a given file.

methods.name: parseNativeCode
methods.description: Parses APK to identify native code libraries and their ABIs.
